annotations.title: Check one email address (syntax, mail servers, throwaway domain, role address)

description: Check ONE email address before you use it. Send the address; get a verdict (deliverable-domain, risky or invalid) and four checks: syntax, the domain's mail servers (public DNS), throwaway domain, and role address (info@, sales@). Signed and dated, so you can keep it as proof of what was checked. Free, no sign-up, 200 checks a day per caller. It never contacts a mail server, never asks whether the mailbox exists, never guesses or suggests an address, takes one address per call (no lists), and stores nothing. 'deliverable-domain' means the domain can receive mail, not that this inbox exists.

address.description: One bare email address such as name@example.com. No display name, no list.
